detail.longDescription: I’m currently a B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student and I’m passionate about programming and learning new technologies. This Hacktoberfest, my goal is to: 🌱 Learn more about open source 🤝 Connect and collaborate with developers 📚 Learn from real-world projects 🚀 Improve my development skills I’m looking forward to exploring open-source projects, contributing wherever I can, and learning from the amazing DEV Community.
